required_concepts: A kite has one pair of equal opposite angles
The given angles do not form a valid kite configuration
acceptable_paraphrases: A kite must have at least one pair of equal opposite angles
One pair of opposite angles in a kite are equal
Kite has one pair of opposite but equal angle
critical_errors: Mistakenly stating that all four angles must be different for the shape not to be a kite
Incorrectly claiming that the total sum of angles is relevant to identifying a kite
misconceptions: believing all four angles must be different for it not to be a kite
thinking the total sum of angles is relevant to identifying a kite
stating that having two acute and two obtuse angles is sufficient to identify a kite
grading_notes: Note that the correct answer should focus on one pair of equal opposite angles, and not include irrelevant information. Misconceptions are common in students' understanding of kite properties.
